title: Car emergency kit: printable checklist
h1: What to keep in your car
metaDesc: A printable car emergency kit checklist: phone charger, jumper cables, flashlight, flares, first-aid kit, water, blankets, tire gauge and winter gear.
first: Jumper cables, a flashlight, and flares or warning triangles.
First-aid kit, blankets, water and snacks that won't spoil.
Tire pressure gauge, and check that the spare and jack are there.
Your roadside help number and insurance card.
dont: Don't let the spare go flat: check its pressure once a month.
Don't wait for winter: add snow gear before the first storm.

steps.h: Keep in the car all year
steps.t: Phone and car charger. Jumper cables. Flashlight and spare batteries. Flares, warning triangles or an emergency flashing light. First-aid kit and any medicine you need. Bottled water and snacks that won't spoil. Tire pressure gauge. Your insurance card, registration and roadside help number written on paper.
Snow shovel, brush and ice scraper. Sand or kitty litter for grip. Warm blanket, hat and gloves.
Spare tire pressure, flashlight batteries, and that the jack and lug wrench are in the car.

call: Save your roadside help number in your phone and on paper, in case your phone dies.

sources.t: AAA Club Alliance: Staying safe when your car breaks down
